title: Baidu AI Cloud’s Yao Minhua: Application + Intelligence = Infinite Possibility
summary: At Unique Capital’s AIGC Application Summit & AIGC100 (Beijing, Oct 17, 2024), Baidu AI Cloud channel GM Yao Minhua spoke on Qianfan driving industry GenAI growth. Edited highlights:
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Interview / Summit talk · October 30, 2024

At Unique Capital’s AIGC Application Summit & AIGC100 (Beijing, Oct 17, 2024), Baidu AI Cloud channel GM Yao Minhua spoke on Qianfan driving industry GenAI growth. Edited highlights:

Models are infrastructure — applications win the future

China AI industry scale cited from ¥138.9B (2020) toward ~¥1T by 2030. Nobel-adjacent AI science wins underline the era. Debate: model vs. app value. Baidu AI Cloud: foundation models are plumbing; value is improving lives and industries. July 2024 Robin Li: shift focus from model races to application innovation. Aug: Character.AI drops pretraining to focus on apps — Silicon Valley consensus that pretraining may concentrate like cloud among a few. Musk: GPT-5 may need 30–50k H100s (>$700M chip cost) → ~80% of firms exit pretraining. Goal: scene-optimized models that beat human workflow performance — not a single leaderboard-topping generalist.

Qianfan in production

As China’s first major model platform, Qianfan after ~1.5 years: ~700M daily calls, 50× YoY call growth, >30k enhanced models, >700k apps on platform — into internet, industry, transport, etc. Qianfan 3.0 (Cloud Intelligence Conference, late Sept): end-to-end data → train → app deploy “Lego” toolchain for beginners and enterprises.

Partner scenes

  • Grassroots government — Village Chief Copilot: App Builder + ERNIE; policy Q&A / high-concurrency citizen demand; ~2M daily calls, serving ~16M people and growing.
  • Quanzhen Medicine: ERNIE Speed AI medical assistant across 45 tertiary public hospitals + >15k clinics; ~150k outpatient draft notes/day.
  • Kuaidi100: smart ship / track / CS — screenshot → status; ship flow 3m40s → 19s; AI CS resolution 95.4%.
  • Gaotu: homework-grading model >95% accuracy; data flywheel for continuous improve.
  • Liepin: ERNIE for résumé screen / Q&A / résumé polish — hiring efficiency +50%+.

Internal Baidu

Baidu Netdisk: “Yun Yiduo” personal smart hub — find docs/audio/video, summarize, video tagging, courseware, audio NL summary. Baidu Wenku: from search to content productivity — reports, mind maps, PPT in minutes.

Cloud + intelligence for every industry

Wanyuan stack around Qianfan + Baige; industry-custom Qianfan; partner last-mile delivery/training/service. Qianfan AI Accelerator for startups: free model courses, cloud credits, fundraising intros. Invitation to co-explore scenes with partners and customers.

— END —
